entries.description: Open protocol for host-domain-signed vacation rental offers: hosts sign offers as Ed25519 compact JWS and publish keys at their own /.well-known/jwks.json. Registry-less by design — verification resolves to the host's domain and nothing else. Specification text CC0, code Apache-2.0. Discovery uses the IANA-registered well-known URI vacation-rental.json.
representativeQueries: open protocol for host-signed vacation rental offers
verify a vacation rental stay offer cryptographically
